command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; $dirty=@(git status --porcelain); if($dirty.Count -ne 0){$dirty|ForEach-Object{Write-Output $_}; throw 'Expected clean checkout before Known Folder baseline.'}; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'fly_known_before.py'; @'

import base64, io, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from pywinauto import Desktop
from pywinauto.keyboard import send_keys
import psutil

user=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
known=[user/"Desktop",user/"Documents",user/"Downloads",user/"Pictures",user/"Music",user/"Videos"]
print("KNOWN_FOLDER_PATHS")
for p in known:
    print(p, p.exists())

# Explorer reference.
subprocess.Popen(["explorer.exe","/separate,",str(user)])
deadline=time.time()+15
ew=None
while time.time()<deadline:
    for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
        try:
            if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe" and user.name.lower() in w.window_text().lower():
                ew=w; break
        except Exception:
            pass
    if ew: break
    time.sleep(.25)
if not ew: raise RuntimeError("Explorer user-profile window not found")
ew.set_focus()
try: ew.move_window(x=30,y=30,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
except Exception: pass
time.sleep(.6)
send_keys("^+2")
time.sleep(1)
print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_ITEMS")
for item in ew.descendants(control_type="ListItem"):
    try:
        name=item.window_text()
        if any(p.name.lower() in name.lower() for p in known):
            r=item.rectangle()
            print(repr((name,r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height())))
    except Exception: pass
img=ew.capture_as_image().convert("RGB"); img.thumbnail((486,360))
buf=io.BytesIO(); img.save(buf,format="JPEG",quality=78,optimize=True)
print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN")
print(base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii"))
print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_SCREENSHOT_END")
try: ew.close()
except Exception: pass

# Current flyExplorer before-change reference using isolated settings.
root=Path(os.environ["TEMP"])/"fly-known-before-env"
if root.exists(): shutil.rmtree(root)
for key in ("localappdata","appdata","temp","tmp"):
    (root/key).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy()
env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(root/"localappdata"); env["APPDATA"]=str(root/"appdata")
env["TEMP"]=str(root/"temp"); env["TMP"]=str(root/"tmp")
pref=Path(env["LOCALAPPDATA"])/"flyExplorer"; pref.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(pref/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
    "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
    encoding="ascii",newline=""
)
exe=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer\out\winui\Release\flyExplorer.exe")
if not exe.exists(): raise RuntimeError("Release flyExplorer missing")
child=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(user)],cwd=exe.parent,env=env)
fw=None; deadline=time.time()+20
while time.time()<deadline:
    if child.poll() is not None: raise RuntimeError(f"flyExplorer exited early {child.returncode}")
    wins=Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=child.pid)
    wins=[w for w in wins if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
    if len(wins)==1: fw=wins[0]; break
    time.sleep(.25)
if not fw: raise RuntimeError("flyExplorer before window not found")
fw.set_focus()
try: fw.move_window(x=30,y=30,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
except Exception: pass
time.sleep(2.5)
print("FLY_BEFORE_KNOWN_ITEMS")
pane=fw.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles")
for item in pane.descendants(control_type="ListItem"):
    try:
        name=item.window_text()
        if any(p.name.lower() in name.lower() for p in known):
            r=item.rectangle()
            images=[x.element_info.name for x in item.descendants(control_type="Image")]
            print(repr((name,r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height(),images)))
    except Exception: pass
img=fw.capture_as_image().convert("RGB"); img.thumbnail((486,360))
buf=io.BytesIO(); img.save(buf,format="JPEG",quality=78,optimize=True)
print("FLY_BEFORE_KNOWN_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN")
print(base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii"))
print("FLY_BEFORE_KNOWN_SCREENSHOT_END")
try:
    import ctypes as c
    c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(fw.handle,0x10,0,0)
    child.wait(timeout=10)
except Exception:
    child.terminate(); child.wait(timeout=8)
print("FLY_BEFORE_EXIT",child.returncode)
shutil.rmtree(root,ignore_errors=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($rc -ne 0){exit $rc}
